caption: The video depicts a side view of a blue hatchback in a dim crash-test hall, its front folded against a fixed silver-grey barrier at the right edge. The crush deepens steadily as the hood, fender and A-pillar fold inward while the windshield cracks and shatters further. The front wheel is shoved rearward into its arch, the tire and surrounding sheet metal compressing. The lower side molding tilts slightly downward toward the front. Inside, an orange dummy in the driver's seat drifts forward, head and torso moving toward the steering column. A second, darker dummy sits faintly in the rear. A trail of small white dots appears near the dummy's head and accumulates across the window. Fine bright debris particles hang in the air above the crumpled front, drifting slowly. The barrier and beams remain fixed as the car continues to move into them. The clip ends with the front still pressed into the barrier and the collapse continuing.
